verdict: Leads up, cost per lead down — but two dark days demand attention.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 30 leads from Meta at a cost of $46.95 per lead — a 50% improvement in cost efficiency compared to the prior week, driven by the August Re-Launch campaign holding strong when spend was active. However, Meta went dark on September 9–10 with zero spend and zero leads on both days, mirroring a similar gap in mid-August; this is being investigated and resolved to prevent further interruptions. On the pipeline side, 30 leads have entered the system but none have advanced to open opportunities in the CRM, which points to an intake process gap rather than an ads issue — we're working to close that leak so leads convert into cases. Next week, you should see uninterrupted ad delivery and the first steps toward automating lead follow-up to capture more value from the traffic already coming in.
